Two quick datapoints: standard PLG policy is 30 days + up to 75k tokens for sandbox trials. For anything beyond that we need an approval from Deal Desk + a commercial sponsor to confirm renewal intent, or an exec exception when the account is strategic.

I want to keep McCann moving — I can escalate for a one-off award of additional tokens and an extension, but I need two things to make the case:
- a short note from your exec sponsor confirming commitment to a procurement timeline and a target go/no-go decision date, and
- a single-paragraph justification of technical validation goals we should track during the extra weeks (e.g., multi-region failover, KV cache scaling).

If you can send those, I'll loop in Deal Desk and request a one-time discretionary grant. I copied Ben so we can capture the exec confirmation.
